title: RFC 3977 §8.1: Article/Head/Body/Stat(None) return 420 instead of 412
description: In lifecycle.rs run_command_loop, the arms for Article(None), Head(None), Body(None), Stat(None) (current-article pointer with no group selected) return Response::new(420, ...) but RFC 3977 §8.1 requires 412 'No newsgroup selected' when no group is active and 420 'Current article number is invalid' when a group is selected but there is no current article. Standard newsreader clients (slrn, tin, Thunderbird) branch on these codes. Fix: return 412 when ctx.state \!= GroupSelected; return 420 only when GroupSelected but no current article.
